caseNameFull: White Motor Co. v. United States
attorneys: Sigmund Timberg on the motion for Serta Associates, Inc., et al., John Bodner, Jr. on the motion for Sandura Company.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Northern District of Ohio. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 369 U. S. 858). The motions of Serta Associates, Inc., et al. and Sandura Company for leave to file briefs, as amid curiae, are granted.
